name: Qatar National Bank (Q.P.S.C.)
summary: Qatar National Bank (Q.P.S.C.), together with its subsidiaries, provides conventional and Islamic banking products and services in Qatar, Europe, North America, rest of GCC countries, and internationally. It operates in four segments: Corporate Banking, Consumer Banking, Asset and Wealth Management, and International Banking. The company offers personal banking products and services, including current, savings, fixed deposit, and call-notice deposit accounts; personal, vehicle, vehicle lease, and mortgage loans, as well as other lending; life, salary continuation, critical illness, motor, mortgage, and travel insurance products; life insurance saving and investment products; asset management…
